items.question: What is the correct size for a LinkedIn banner?
items.answer: The recommended size for a personal LinkedIn background photo is 1584 x 396 pixels. Lovart automatically defaults to this ratio when you select the 'LinkedIn Header' template, ensuring no important details are cropped out.

items.question: Can I add text to my AI-generated banner?
items.answer: Yes! Unlike standard image generators, Lovart has a dedicated 'Edit Text' feature. You can add your headline, slogan, or contact information directly onto the generated background with professional font options.

items.question: How do I make sure my profile picture doesn't cover the design?
items.answer: Lovart's Design Agent is trained on layout composition. When you describe your request, the AI typically places key visual elements to the right or top, keeping the 'safe zone' (where your photo sits) clear of critical details.

items.question: Is this suitable for company pages too?
items.answer: Absolutely. Company pages have slightly different dimensions (1128 x 191 px), and Lovart supports this format as well. You can create branded banners for your corporate page just as easily as for personal profiles.

items.question: Can I use my company logo?
items.answer: Yes, you can upload your company logo to the canvas or your Brand Kit. You can then position it perfectly on the banner using the 'Edit Elements' tool to ensure brand visibility.
